study.title: Impact of empagliflozin added on to basal insulin in type 2 diabetes inadequately controlled on basal insulin: a 78-week randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial
study.authors: Rosenstock J, Jelaska A, Zeller C, Kim G, Broedl UC, Woerle HJ; EMPA-REG BASAL trial investigators
study.condition: Type 2 diabetes inadequately controlled on basal insulin

master_study_rows: Impact of empagliflozin added on to basal insulin in type 2 diabetes inadequately controlled on basal insulin: a 78-week randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial
Type 2 diabetes inadequately controlled on basal insulin

eligibility.qualifier: agent for >=7 days were considered as res-
Established diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus
HbA1c >=7% (>=53 mmol/mol) at baseline who had HbA1c <7%
Standard medical therapy at stable doses prior to enrollment
Written informed consent obtained from all patients
End-stage renal disease or maintenance dialysis
Coronary revascularization, acute coronary syndrome, or stroke within 12 weeks

treatment with insulin, glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) analogues, sulfonylurea at > half the daily maximum approved dose or thiazolidinedione within 12 weeks prior to consent | Insulin, GLP-1 analogues, Sulfonylurea (> half max approved daily dose), Thiazolidinedione (within 12 weeks prior to consent)
investigational drug intake within 30 days of consent | Prohibited within 30 days of consent
